title: James Fox: smoking-gun evidence keeps disappearing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of James Fox: smoking-gun evidence keeps disappearing, about decades of research at Austin, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: themselves I mean we were with James Fox the other week in Austin great guy and I was talking to him

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he was with James Fox, a filmmaker who has spent decades investigating UFOs, in Austin, and talked with him there. According to Michels, Fox's point was that whenever decisive, smoking-gun evidence seems to appear, it keeps disappearing, which, if true, would explain why proof never quite surfaces.
